news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Crosses Rs 165 Crore Globally Following Solid Monday Hold
news.summary: Despite a divided critical response, Srikanth Odela's directorial venture starring Nani pulled in roughly Rs 10 crore on its first Monday. news.title: Prabhas's Lineup Sparks Debate Over Whether Spirit Will Arrive Before Fauzi
news.summary: Prabhas has multiple high-profile projects in the pipeline, leading to intense discussions regarding the release timelines for Fauzi and Spirit. While the Hanu Raghavapudi directorial Fauzi was initially slated for a December 2026 premiere, the actor urged filmmakers to prioritize quality over haste, leading them to step back and focus on post-production. Consequently, industry circles widely anticipate that Sandeep Vanga's directorial project Spirit, featuring Prabhas as a police officer, may hit screens first in March 2027.

news.title: Hyderabad Cinema Hall Penalized Over Excessive Commercial Playtime
news.summary: A local consumer court has penalized a Hyderabad theater a total of Rs 75,000 for making moviegoers endure over 22 minutes of advertisements prior to a screening of Kubera. The penalty includes compensation directed to the aggrieved viewer alongside a fine payable to the district consumer bench. This ruling highlights ongoing viewer grievances regarding prolonged promotional runtimes before scheduled showtimes.
